title: Platforms for Humans and Machines: Engineering for the Age of Agents — Juan Herreros Elorza
talk_summary: Juan argues that internal platforms must be designed for agents as first-class users: self-service, API-based, local-first, documented, observable, and measured. He frames agent-readiness as an accelerator for long-standing platform best practices, with guardrails and contribution paths.

takeaways.technique: Remove human handoffs from agent workflows
takeaways.what_they_do: Audit every workflow where an agent waits on a human or another team for resources, credentials, deploys, or approvals, then convert those steps into agent-triggerable self-service actions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: There should be no process that requires talking to a specific person or waiting for a specific person to do something.

takeaways.what_they_do: Put well-defined, discoverable APIs under CLIs, MCP servers, or plugins, with schema validation and auth so agents can call tools and iterate on responses.
takeaways.evidence_quote: agents are good at calling well-defined APIs

takeaways.technique: Shift-left preflight before CI or remote sandbox
takeaways.what_they_do: Validate work locally or early before pushing to version control or waiting for a pipeline, so failures surface immediately.
takeaways.evidence_quote: If something is going to fail, it should fail as soon as possible.

takeaways.what_they_do: Expose logs, metrics, traces, CI status, and other verification signals via API, CLI, or MCP, and tell the agent explicit success criteria so it can close its own loop.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Make those logs, metrics, traces, everything that can help available via an API or via CLI or an MCP server

takeaways.what_they_do: Keep documentation next to the code it documents, or centralize it behind an API, and codify build/test/deploy/verify conventions in AGENTS.md-style files and skills.
takeaways.evidence_quote: keep your documentation next to the code it's documenting

takeaways.what_they_do: Define target outcomes before changing the platform, then compare before/after metrics such as support requests, delivery metrics, reliability, or agent-specific bottlenecks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: measure whether you actually succeeded at that or not
